candidates.why_relevant: The only association representing banks in Slovakia (founded 1993; ~29 members / 25 banks, ~100% of sector assets). Its stated mission is to optimise the legal environment in banking and cooperate with state bodies on drafting acts and regulations, so it is the single richest non-state source of sector positions on draft banking/payments law, supervision practice and implementation deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the site tree (novinky, projekty-a-standardy, o-nas) plus RSS/HTML diffing; snapshot member list for pointer expansion.
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia stanovisko návrh zákona
Slovak Banking Association EBF member national banking association Slovakia position paper

candidates.why_relevant: SBA has no separate 'stanoviská' section; positions on draft legislation, levy/tax measures, banking-secrecy concerns and sector statistics are published as news items tagged by category (e.g. 'Štatistiky a analýzy'). This is the practical feed for early, candid sector reaction to draft rules.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape with pagination + category tags; store title/date/body; alert on keywords (zákon, novela, návrh, pripomienky, smernica, nariadenie).
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia stanovisko návrh zákona

candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative roster of banks and branches of foreign banks operating in SK plus associate members. POINTER data: seeds the whole private-bank actor map for other workstreams (vendor wins, tenders, PSD2/instant-payments rollouts) and lets you attribute positions to specific institutions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape into an entity table (name, website, member type); diff to detect market entries/exits.
queries_used: Slovak Banking Association EBF member national banking association Slovakia position paper

candidates.source_name: SBA — Projekty a štandardy (self-regulatory projects & standards)
candidates.why_relevant: Where SBA documents sector-level self-regulation and shared infrastructure/standards (e.g. the SBA Institute of Alternative Dispute Resolution, codes, common standards). Self-regulatory standards often pre-empt or implement EU payments rules and are a leading indicator of what banks will require from vendors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl project sub-pages and attached PDFs; version-track standard/code documents.
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia stanovisko návrh zákona

candidates.source_name: EBF — Slovakia country page (SBA in the European federation)
candidates.why_relevant: SBA has been an EBF and European Payment Council member since 1996. The EBF country page and EBF position papers carry the English-language framing of Slovak bank positions on EU files (PSD3/PSR, instant payments, digital euro, AMLR) and give comparable cross-country context.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor EBF publications/position-paper feed filtered for SK relevance; use country page for structural facts.
queries_used: Slovak Banking Association EBF member national banking association Slovakia position paper

candidates.source_name: EU Transparency Register / LobbyFacts datacard — Slovenská banková asociácia
candidates.why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly source: registered lobbying declarations expose which EU legislative files SBA declares an interest in, budget, staff and meetings — an early signal of which regulatory dossiers the Slovak banking sector is actively working, independent of what SBA chooses to publish.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual pull of the datacard + the underlying EU Transparency Register entry (register ID 026897317691-75); diff declared files of interest.
queries_used: Slovak Banking Association EBF member national banking association Slovakia position paper

candidates.why_relevant: Founded Aug 2018; explicitly a platform for communication between fintech entities and regulators, forming working groups and holding open discussions with government. Founding member of EDFA. Publishes blog/news and thematic sections (crypto & blockchain) that track MiCA, sandbox and payments regulation debate earlier and more candidly than banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape blog + eventy_novinky + thematic pages; watch for consultation responses and national fintech strategy inputs.
queries_used: fintech asociácia Slovensko platby regulácia pripomienky

candidates.why_relevant: Member roster of the Slovak fintech/payments ecosystem — the pointer that maps non-bank PSPs, e-money firms, crypto and infrastructure vendors active in SK. Membership page plus the separate 'Členstvo' page for joining criteria.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape into entity table; cross-reference against NBS licence registers for licensing status.
queries_used: "slovakfintech.sk" členovia asociácie fintech Slovensko zoznam

candidates.source_name: FinReport.sk — fintech & banking trade press (association-position reporting)
candidates.why_relevant: Specialist SK financial trade outlet that quotes association positions verbatim (SBA on banking secrecy, Fintech & Insurtech association on the national fintech strategy, commission-cap debates) and carries an encyclopedia of SK financial institutions. Best proxy when associations publish nothing themselves.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/section scraping of banky-a-poistovne and fintech sections; extract association names as entities, store link + short quote only.
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia stanovisko návrh zákona
fintech asociácia Slovensko platby regulácia pripomienky

candidates.source_name: Slov-Lex — legislatívne procesy / hromadné pripomienky (association comments on drafts)
candidates.why_relevant: Since April 2016 all inter-ministerial comment procedures (MPK) are run here. Association comments — including bulk/collective comments (hromadné pripomienky) — are filed and published per LP/YYYY/NNN case with their disposition. This is the authoritative, timestamped record of what each association actually asked for and what the ministry accepted, plus the statutory comment deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track LP case IDs for MF SR / NBS-related drafts; render JS (headless browser) or use portal APIs to pull the comments tab and hromadné-pripomienky tab; filter comment authors by association name.
queries_used: slov-lex.sk medzirezortné pripomienkové konanie hromadná pripomienka Slovenská banková asociácia LP
candidates.observed_blocker: Search results note portal pages require JavaScript to display content; static fetch may return an empty shell. Treated as hypothesis, not dead.

candidates.source_name: HSR — Hospodárska a sociálna rada SR (tripartite) association position papers
candidates.why_relevant: The tripartite council portal publishes formal written positions ('STANOVISKO REPUBLIKOVEJ ÚNIE ZAMESTNÁVATEĽOV' etc.) from employer confederations on draft laws, including AML/financial-system files. Employer bodies channel banking/fintech member concerns when a sector association is not itself a tripartite member.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest per-meeting attachment lists (data/att/*.pdf|doc); OCR/parse PDFs; index by submitting organisation and by draft law.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk search snowball on employer confederations
queries_used: Republiková únia zamestnávateľov RÚZ AZZZ SOPK stanoviská pripomienky finančný trh zákon o bankách

candidates.source_name: LRV — Legislatívna rada vlády SR: vyhodnotenie MPK documents
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes the 'Vyhodnotenie medzirezortného pripomienkového konania' documents that list every commenting body (SLASPO, SBA, employer unions, etc.), their exact comment text, and whether it was accepted — a compact, machine-parseable record of association influence on financial-sector drafts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl data/att/ attachment IDs for .doc/.pdf; parse tables of commenter / comment / disposition; entity-link commenter names to the association map.
queries_used: Slovenská asociácia poisťovní SLASPO Republiková únia zamestnávateľov pripomienkové konanie finančný sektor

candidates.why_relevant: Interest association of commercial insurers; activities explicitly focused on legislation, insurance economics, education. Relevant to sector=both because insurers are co-affected by IRRD, DORA, AML and distribution rules, and SLASPO appears as a named commenter in MPK evaluation documents.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape news/legislation sections and member list; monitor for stanoviská and annual reports.
queries_used: Slovenská asociácia poisťovní SLASPO Republiková únia zamestnávateľov pripomienkové konanie finančný sektor

candidates.why_relevant: Association of SK asset-management companies (est. 1998) whose stated priority is cooperation with state legislative bodies in drafting financial-market legal norms. Explicitly names SBA and AOCP as partner associations — useful cross-link for the actor map.

Association-convened conferences are where policy asks are first stated aloud, months before formal consultation. No standalone Finweek domain was confirmed, so tracked via the association's events page and trade-press coverage.

negative_findings.description: SBA's website navigation (Úvod, Novinky, Členovia, Projekty a štandardy, O nás, Kontakt) contains no dedicated 'Stanoviská' / 'Pozičné dokumenty' / 'Publikácie' section, contrary to the seed-query assumption that a position-paper archive exists.
negative_findings.result_summary: Positions appear to be published as ordinary news items under /novinky/ with category tags; there is no separate, stable position-paper archive URL to anchor collection on.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must scrape and classify the news stream rather than a clean position-paper index, and historical positions may be hard to retrieve; a Wayback-based backfill of /novinky/ should be planned.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak association of payment institutions / e-money institutions (a 'asociácia platobných inštitúcií' equivalent to EPIF or the EMA) was found in either Slovak or English searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'platobné inštitúcie združenie' returned leasing, securities-dealer and collection associations, but no payments-specific trade body. Non-bank payments interests appear to be carried by the Slovenská FinTech asociácia instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For payments regulation specifically, there is no single dedicated national voice; the collection plan must rely on the fintech association, SBA, and EU-level bodies (EPC via SBA, EDFA) rather than a SK payments association that may not exist.

negative_findings.description: Two distinct-sounding fintech bodies surfaced: 'Slovenská FinTech asociácia' (slovakfintech.sk, est. 2018, IČO 51910497) and a 'Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia' led by president Davy Čajko cited in the National FinTech Strategy coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: It is unclear from the evidence gathered whether these are the same organisation under a rebranded name, or two competing bodies. No separate website for the latter was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Attribution of fintech positions could be wrong, and one of the two bodies may be an uncollected source. Needs a targeted resolution step (ORSR/FinStat lookup on the president's name and on both trade names).

negative_findings.description: AOCP (Asociácia obchodníkov s cennými papiermi, the securities dealers' association) was confirmed to exist only indirectly, as a named partner association of SASS.
negative_findings.result_summary: No AOCP website, member list or position page was located in this pass; only third-party mentions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A capital-markets trade body relevant to MiFID/DORA/T+1 files is currently unaddressable. Needs a targeted follow-up search for its domain, or ORSR lookup.

negative_findings.description: Chambers of commerce with a plausible financial-sector policy role — SOPK (Slovenská obchodná a priemyselná komora) and AmCham Slovakia — produced no financial-regulation-specific hits despite both Slovak and English querying.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining SOPK/AmCham with 'fintech', 'pracovná skupina', 'regulácia', 'zákon o bankách' returned no chamber position papers or working-group pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Chambers may still run relevant committees; absence of evidence here is not evidence of absence, but they should not be scheduled for collection until a targeted site-level check is done.

negative_findings.description: The Slov-Lex legislative-process portal — the authoritative record of association comments in the inter-ministerial comment procedure — is JavaScript-rendered.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search-result metadata indicates the legislative-process and hromadné-pripomienky pages require JavaScript to display content; a plain HTTP fetch is expected to return an empty shell. Not tested directly in this pass, so this is a hypothesis, not a verdict.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single highest-value consultation source needs a headless-browser or API-based collector rather than simple HTTP scraping; budget for that in the collection architecture.

negative_findings.description: Three candidate URLs were constructed or inferred rather than observed: ruzsr.sk (RÚZ), blockchainslovakia.sk, and edfa.eu.
negative_findings.result_summary: Each organisation was confirmed to exist through independent evidence (HSR position PDF, Facebook page, SFA cooperation-agreement article), but their canonical domains were not returned by any search result.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These must be resolved by the deterministic liveness/verification pass before being scheduled for collection; they are flagged with low confidence_score and access_status 'unverified'.

coverage_gaps.description: No association-level archive of past position papers was identified; SBA and the fintech association publish rolling news without an obvious document repository, and site search/pagination depth is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill via the Internet Archive for sbaonline.sk/novinky/ and slovakfintech.sk/blog/ across at least 5 years, and cross-check against LRV 'vyhodnotenie MPK' documents which preserve comment text verbatim.

coverage_gaps.description: The payments-specific and capital-markets-specific association layer is thin: no SK payments-institution association found, AOCP unaddressable, and the crypto bodies (SKMA, Blockchain Slovakia) unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted second pass using ORSR/register-of-legal-persons searches on 'asociácia' + 'platobn*', 'obchodníkov s cennými papiermi', 'kryptomen*' to obtain IČOs and registered websites, rather than relying on web search.

coverage_gaps.description: Member lists for SBA, SFA and ALS were located as URLs but their actual contents were not extracted in this pass, so the pointer value is identified but not yet realised.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse /clenovia/, /riadni-clenovia and the SFA members page into a normalised actor table, then reconcile against the NBS register of licensed entities to distinguish licensed institutions from vendors/observers.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language mirrors exist for SBA (/en/) and AFISP (/en/) but were not compared against the Slovak originals; other associations appear Slovak-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample-compare sk vs en pages for SBA to determine whether the English site is a reduced subset (likely), and default all collection to the Slovak version with English used only for cross-country comparability.

coverage_gaps.description: A meaningful share of association output flows through LinkedIn and Facebook, both of which are login-walled and ToS-restricted for automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do not scrape these platforms; instead schedule a light manual review cadence for SBA and SFA social channels, and treat trade press (FinReport) as the collectable proxy that surfaces the same statements.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-legislative influence (PI — predbežná informácia stage, ministry working groups, NBS advisory bodies) is only partially covered; associations are known to comment at the PI stage but no systematic feed for this was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the Slov-Lex collector to the 'predbežná informácia' (PI/YYYY/NNN) case type as well as LP cases, and monitor MF SR and NBS working-group announcements for association membership.

brief: Slovakia's banking/payments association layer is dominated by one heavyweight — Slovenská banková asociácia (sbaonline.sk), an EBF and European Payment Council member covering effectively 100% of banking-sector assets — plus a much smaller but more candid Slovenská FinTech asociácia (slovakfintech.sk), an EDFA founding member that convenes the National FinTech Strategy debate. Neither publishes a clean position-paper archive: SBA folds its stanoviská into a tagged news stream, so the authoritative, timestamped record of what associations actually asked for lives in state consultation infrastructure instead — Slov-Lex legislative processes and hromadné pripomienky, the LRV 'vyhodnotenie MPK' documents, and HSR tripartite position PDFs — which together should be treated as the primary collection target for this cell. A secondary ring of sectoral associations (SLASPO, SASS, AFISP, ALS SR, ASINS) and employer confederations (RÚZ, AZZZ) carries adjacent regulation, and association member lists across SBA/SFA/ALS are the best pointer data for mapping the whole private financial ecosystem. Main gaps: no payments-institution-specific trade body appears to exist, AOCP and the crypto associations lack verified domains, and Slov-Lex is JavaScript-rendered so it needs a headless collector rather than plain HTTP scraping.
